title: Children's app interface saturation, brightness, and hue use
statement:
Children's application interfaces use higher saturation and brightness than adult interfaces; educational apps favor cool hues while game apps favor warm hues.

Options:
- Cool educational: high-sat blue #00BFFF (fits: edtech, learning app)
- Warm playful: high-sat red/orange #FF4500 (fits: game app, entertainment)
- Child-bright: bright pastels high brightness (fits: preschool, fun)
- Mature kid: lower-sat adult-like palette (fits: older children 9-11)
appliesWhen: Applies to: kids. Audience: children under 10, parents.

source.title: Color design in application interfaces for children
source.authors: F. Lyu; R. Xi; Y. Liu
